title: Official Game Center venue spot-checks against the published schedule table
method: The schedule table's Stadium column comes from the reconciled nflverse feed (source S47, third-party, flagged). This register spot-checks that column against the OFFICIAL Game Center page of each game, which publishes Location and Stadium in its Game Info block. A spot-check is evidence about the sample checked, never a certification of the whole column - the 270 unchecked rows stay labelled third-party.

rows.game_book_note: The official Game Center also exposes a 'Download Game Book (PDF)' link, confirming the league publishes per-game official Game Books (URL captured on the page; large PDF not archived this session).
Game Book PDF link present on the page. The official venue name confirms the feed's Munich naming, which the home-field flag (F21) treats as an international neutral-site game.

game_book_evidence.finding: Both Game Centers read this session expose the official per-game Game Book PDF link. This upgrades the brief item 'use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status' from blocked to PATH-KNOWN: the documents are reachable; the missing piece is a parser and storage, not access.

open_items: 270 of 272 rows remain officially unchecked; automating a per-game Game Center read in the weekly refresh workflow is registered as SG36.
Pregame Game Centers (future weeks) were not tested this session; whether the venue block renders before kickoff is unverified.
